kind_group_head: Group head: other nodes can belong to it (e.g. a character)
kind_attribute: Attribute: usually belongs to a group head (hair, costume, pose…)
kind_situation: Situation: whole scene or one group head
kind_scene: Scene: applies to the whole image (location, style, lighting…)

title: Categories — {library}
intro: Categories belong to this library. The kind decides behavior; the name is only a label and can be renamed freely. Locked categories can't be deleted (unlock them first). Order here is the default prompt order.
removeName: Remove the {locale} name (falls back to another language)
belongsTip: Nodes of this category can belong to a group head (e.g. a character)
hasColorTip: Adds a color picker; {color} in keywords is replaced
deleteTip: Delete this category (asks first if it has presets)
